title: What's New or Changed in Business Central 2026 release wave 1 - Update 28.0 preview
summary: Business Central update 28.0 for 2026 release wave 1 introduces new capabilities across Copilot and agents, supply chain management, financial management, reporting, development tools, and regional features for countries including Czechia and Germany.
features: Enhanced MCP server for agentic experiences
Manage tasks from all agents in task pane
Review content generated by agents on pages
Show avatars for record creators and modifiers
Stop all active tasks for selected agent
External storage support for document attachments
Create purchase orders from drop shipments
Match purchase invoices to multiple lines
Post purchase invoices for drop shipments independently
